mapper.select: SELECT dr.*, COALESCE(d.building, dr.building, CONVERT(ud.building USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) AS building, COALESCE(d.room_no, dr.room_no, CONVERT(ud.room USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) AS room_no, u.username, u.real_name, u.phone, hu.real_name AS handler_name FROM dormitory_repair dr LEFT JOIN dormitory d ON dr.dormitory_id = d.id LEFT JOIN user_dormitory ud ON dr.user_id = ud.user_id INNER JOIN user u ON dr.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN user hu ON dr.handler_id = hu.user_id WHERE dr.id = #{id}

SELECT dr.*, COALESCE(d.building, dr.building, CONVERT(ud.building USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) AS building, COALESCE(d.room_no, dr.room_no, CONVERT(ud.room USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) AS room_no, u.username, u.real_name, u.phone, hu.real_name AS handler_name FROM dormitory_repair dr LEFT JOIN dormitory d ON dr.dormitory_id = d.id LEFT JOIN user_dormitory ud ON dr.user_id = ud.user_id INNER JOIN user u ON dr.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN user hu ON dr.handler_id = hu.user_id WHERE dr.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE dr.urgency WHEN 'high' THEN 1 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, dr.create_time ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dormitory_repair WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dormitory_repair (dormitory_id, campus, building, room_no, user_id, description, images, urgency, status) VALUES (#{dormitoryId}, #{campus}, #{building}, #{roomNo}, #{userId}, #{description}, #{images}, #{urgency}, 'PENDING')
mapper.update: UPDATE dormitory_repair SET status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, handle_images = #{handleImages}, handler_id = #{handlerId}, handle_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE dormitory_repair SET description = #{description}, urgency = #{urgency}, images = #{images}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'CANCELLED'
UPDATE dormitory_repair SET status = 'PENDING', create_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'CANCELLED'
UPDATE dormitory_repair SET dormitory_id = #{dormitoryId}, campus = #{campus}, building = #{building}, room_no = #{roomNo}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE dormitory_repair SET status = 'PROCESSING', handler_id = #{handlerId}, processing_started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE dormitory_repair SET status = 'COMPLETED', remark = #{remark}, handle_images = #{handleImages}, handle_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE dormitory_repair SET building = #{newBuilding}, campus = #{campus}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE building = #{oldBuilding}
